name: ChatSuey v1.2.0
body:
## Change Log
- Added new FontSettings addon.
- Added new MiniChannels addon.
- Added new ChannelLinks addon.
- Added new Mentions addon.
- Updated the "demonhunter" color used with [Markdown Links](https://scott.software/chatsuey/#markdown) to reflect the final class color used in Legion (ChatSuey is still for vanilla WoW, though!).
- Worked around a [conflict with Auctioneer](https://github.com/ScottHamper/chatsuey/issues/3).
- Localized ChatSuey for French (frFR) and Simplified Chinese (zhCN) clients.

**HUGE THANK YOU** to [@eloib](https://github.com/eloib) for providing the French/Simplified Chinese translations!
